subject: Q3 Goal Certification & Risk Acceptance — OKR packet for leadership review
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: chris.park@acmeai.com, emma@acmeai.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Goal Certification & Risk Acceptance — OKR packet for leadership review

Team — attaching the working Q3 OKR packet and risk register for leadership certification. High-level ask below; please read and respond by EOD Wed 2027-06-16 with either: (1) "ACK" to certify, (2) a one-line objection, or (3) a confirmed owner change. If you have detailed edits, add comments to the Google Doc (link below) — I will consolidate.

Quick highlights (draft):
- Objective A: Make hosted inference 2x cheaper for small-burst workloads — Owner: Marissa Cole — KPI: cost-per-1k-tokens (p95) down 45% vs. baseline.
- Objective B: Deliver Dedicated autoscaling + SLA playbook — Owner: Marcus Lin — KPI: 99.9% throughput SLA during business hours.
- Objective C: Private deployment readiness for EU regulated customers — Owner: Laura Bennett — KPI: two regulated customers onboarded (pilot -> production).

Open risk callouts (see attached risk register):
- Risk 1: GPU supply variability impacting Dedicated capacity lead time.
- Risk 2: Compliance gap on EU key rotation timelines for Private (mitigation: KMS integration plan in appendix).

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm owner & KPI correctness for any objectives you own.
2) Flag any risk you are unwilling to accept (call out for exec decision).
3) Confirm budget uplift for Dedicated ramp (finance will weigh in, cc procurement contact included).

Action timeline:
- Wed 6/16 EOD: leadership certifications due
- Thu 6/17 AM: finalize packet for QBR deck

Google Doc (comments): https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE_Q3_OKR
Attachments: q3_okr_packet_v1.pdf, q3_risk_register.xlsx

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Goal Certification & Risk Acceptance — OKR packet for leadership review

On Tue, 15 Jun 2027 at 09:12, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — attaching the working Q3 OKR packet and risk register for leadership certification...

Rishi — quick clarifications from product/engineering POV:
- Objective A: The cost target looks aggressive relative to our current batching telemetry. Recommend rephrasing KPI to "cost-per-1k-tokens (p95) down ~35%" unless we take a parallel quantization experiment as part of the objective. Otherwise we risk scope creep into low-level infra work.
- For Objective B, Marcus is listed as owner; Marcus, can you confirm the SLA definition (target window + measured metric)? Is the SLA targeted at p95 latency or throughput?

I can approve the packet if we soften Objective A KPI and add a line item in the risk register about experimental quantization fallback (owner: Marissa). Happy to take the follow-up to scope the experiment.

—Marissa
Director, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Goal Certification & Risk Acceptance — OKR packet for leadership review

Rishi / team — thanks for drafting. A couple notes: 
- Objective C (Private deployment readiness): I support certifying this as long as procurement confirms the third-party KMS SLA and finance signs off on the compliance integration budget. I've looped in Karthik for financial confirmation.
- Risk Acceptance: I think we can accept Risk 2 conditionally, but we need an explicit rollback plan if EU key rotation hits a showstopper during pilot. Please add a short rollback bullet in the risk register.

If procurement/finance come back clean by EOD tomorrow, I will ACK.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Chris Park <chris.park@acmeai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: emma@acmeai.com, procurement@acmeai.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Goal Certification & Risk Acceptance — OKR packet for leadership review

Rishi — thanks for sharing the packet; Acme AI is generally aligned with Objective C and the compliance timeline looks feasible from our side. A couple asks on our end: 
- Can you confirm approximate rollout dates for a Private pilot and what level of support Redwood will provide for key rotation testing?
- We'd like a 30-min sync on Wed 6/16 to walk the compliance appendix with our security lead (Emma). Are you available 10:00–10:30 AM or 3:00–3:30 PM PT?

Thanks,
Chris Park
Director, Platform Partnerships
Acme AI

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: chris.park@acmeai.com, emma@acmeai.com, procurement@acmeai.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Goal Certification & Risk Acceptance — OKR packet for leadership review

Team — thanks for the quick input. Consolidating decisions and next steps below (finalize by EOD):

Decisions / updates:
- Objective A KPI: we'll move to the conservative KPI Marissa recommended (p95 down ~35%) and add the quantization experiment as a supporting KR (owner: Marissa).
- Objective B SLA: Marcus to confirm whether SLA will be measured on p95 latency or throughput by EOD tomorrow.
- Objective C: Laura will ACK if procurement/finance confirm budget/SLA. Karthik, can you confirm finance uplift (yes/no) by EOD?
- Risk register: added rollback bullet for Key Rotation (see q3_risk_register.xlsx).

Action items (owner — due):
- Marissa: scope quantization experiment + deliver experiment plan (6/24).
- Marcus: confirm SLA measurement and update playbook (6/18).
- Karthik: finance confirmation on compliance integration budget (6/16 EOD).
- Laura: final ACK once procurement signoff received (6/16 EOD).
- Rishi: incorporate final edits and publish QBR packet (6/17 AM).

Chris — thanks for the request; 10:00–10:30 AM PT on Wed 6/16 works for us. I'll send a calendar invite to include Emma and procurement.

Attachments: q3_okr_packet_v1.pdf, q3_risk_register.xlsx, owners_rollup_sheet.csv

Please reply with short confirmation (ACK or open objection) when you see this so I can lock the packet for the QBR deck tomorrow morning.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
